nom: The Ordinary Marine Hyaluronic Moisture Lock Serum

avis.titre: Great alternative to the $100 bottle of Elemis
avis.texte: Love it. Was using Elemis which is very expensive. Was hoping it was similar. I'm begging to love this line of products and gradually changing over. Great selection of products. Would highly recommend to try if you haven't.
I really like this. My skin stays soft for hours, and this product is a little lighter and less sticky than the regular HA serum
I've had dry skin all of my life. Now in perimenopuse my skin is starting to be extra dry. This serum is a lifesaver. It moisturizes to the gods. Will be buying again
I figured I'd try a less expensive brand than usual and im so glad i did! I was amazed at how much this lightweight formula hydrated my skin. I use twice a day and love it

i generally have dry skin (especially during the colder months) which can be sensitive sometimes. i LOVE this serum. the consistency is basically like water & i use it directly after my cleanser & it leaves the skin very hydrated throughtout the day. highly recommend 🩷

I have oily skin and thought I could get away with not moisturizing until I hit my mid-40s…Bought this by accident and noticed the roughness of my fingertips immediately resolved. Facial eczema resolved. Elbows and knees are softer. I use it to prep any part of my body before any treatment. It smoothes and eliminates any dry patches without greasiness or that goopy serum texture. I wish they sold it in a mist, and in a value size, but a little goes a long way. Can't wait to use this in summer. Will repurchase.
This is like water. Not sure if it works yet but if looking fir a traditional slightly fel like stsbdard HA serum, keep looking

I was having excessive flaking in my forehead from using prescription retinol. I like using this serum and a moisturizer at least a 1/2 before the prescription retinol has done wonders for my skin. I'm happy I found a solution for my dry skin before winter.
One of the best hydrating products I have ever used! Absorbs fast and deeply hydrates.

avis.titre: would buy a jumbo if they sold it
avis.texte: this is a great hydrating serum for oily skin! absorbs easily, soothes rough patches, doesn't clog pores. a lot of hyaluronic acid serums are too thick and make me shinier, but the watery texture of this is perfect. it seriously saved me when I irritated my skin starting retinaldehyde. wish they sold a value size.

This product made my face so moisturized even after only one use. I put this on before my moisturizer, for dry skin this is a great product. I will continue to buy it. Better then the last serum I bought and way cheaper.
Watery textured moisture that is non-irritating and absorbs easily!

avis.titre: Good to use with NuDerma device
avis.texte: I bought this to use with my NuDerma device. It requires a good serum for gliding across your skin. I bought this due to the suggestion that a couple of reviewers made because it's super cheap and you have to usea lot of it.The only thing with this is that it does peel afterwards. I'm not sure if it's because I have to put a lot on in order for the glass to not catch on my skin. I wouldn't use this for anything else because it doesn't seem like it's that hydrating and it doesn't seem like it soaks in very well. For a hydrating hyaluronic acid I really like the Paula's choice hyaluronic acid booster.

avis.titre: to watery but its so good!
avis.texte: It's so good but it's watery it just when I apply it. It just goes down my face four stars.!

avis.titre: to watery but its so good!
avis.texte: It's so good but it's watery it just when I apply it. It just goes down my face four stars.!
this performs just as well as much more expensive brands so this is my second bottle after using the other to the bottom of the jar
I like this watey consistency , cuz it doesn't have thickener！some profucts have thickener that can make pilling or some residues!
I like this watey consistency , cuz it doesn't have thickener！some profucts have thickener that can make pilling or some residues!
This product is a good product but it's very watery and runs down your face super fast when you apply it.
This serum is "meh." It didn't hurt my skin, but didn't help it either. It's very watery and not as hydrating as other products on the market. Save your money and go with something else.

I purchased this by mistake the first time-I was going for the regular hyaluronic which have a thicker consistency like most serums. This works great during those HOT HOT months!!! Yes, it's thin and watery which is a plus in the summer time. It absorbs QUICKLY! Those heavier serums don't compare when it's hot, humid and muggy outside.

This is my second time purchasing this item as it has made a great impact in my regimen. I use this product as a mid day hydration boost or post chemical exfoliant. It's been a game changer! I am 10 years into my skincare journey and would consider myself an advanced user. I am 30 years old but would have introduced this to my routine long ago!

avis.titre: DON'T USE IF YOU'RE ALLERGIC TO SHELLFISH
avis.texte: Lesson learned, I did a patch test of this on the sides of my face just in case I got an allergic reaction. Sure enough yup. BIG reaction! My face immediately started swelling up, tingling, and even getting NUMB!!! I took a Benadryl right away cause I was actually starting to panic. I had only seen one review of someone with a shellfish allergy getting a reaction, but I thought what are the chances I would? Pretty high apparently. The Ordinary, PLEASE put a disclaimer on this product for those with seafood/shellfish allergies! Wish I could've liked this product, sad to return it but just glad my reaction didn't get too severe.
I notice a difference in my skin when I use this. Love it so much I bought 2 more bottles.
Other products come and go but she stays. Great way to recover a surprising amount of moisture post cleanse while being so light that it doesn't interfere with products applied after.

avis.titre: Light on the skin and less pilling
avis.texte: I like this marine hyaluronic vs their regular hyaluronic because it absorbs faster and my skin doesnt feel tacky after it dries. For those complaining its too watery, try The Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid 2%

avis.titre: Keeps my face hydrated all day
avis.texte: I started using this about a year ago and always come back to if even after trying other products. I use it after the cold pressed oil and my face is hydrated all day!

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: It was too runny of a product for me. I was expecting a thicker substance.

This is my 1st "The Ordinary" review ever! And I had to have it be about this one! It works great and soothes, hydrates. I prefer it over the regular Hyaluronic. Personally, I've had THEE best luck with all their products, but it's because I know my skin/sensitives etc and I researched SEVERAL sources before using, went slow, patch tested etc. I have ONLY positive to say about these products! I'm always checking to see if they will keep creating new things!
Feels like you are putting water on your face and it comes out of the dropper too fast because its so thin.
Plzzz im begging make this in 120 ml. It's soooooo good for my skin

I've struggled with hormonal acne for most of my life, and therefore have struggled with finding good moisturizer for my skin that don't break me out. This one is a safe bet and keeps my skin feeling soft all day! I will definitely be buying it again.
I feel like using my fingers wastes alot. Do you use a cotton ball or brush? What's the best method of application?

This is my go to for any Hyaluronic ever. I know the serum with B5 is much more popular, but I already have so many serums going that I wanted the affect of the hyaluronic without the added slime. This stuff is thin as water! I put this on after my glycolic / toner and before my serums, day and night. I've lost count of how many bottles I've been through at this point. I don't have many consistent items in my arsenal besides this.

avis.titre: Awesome For Dry Skin in SUPER Dry Environment!
avis.texte: I've used The Ordinary's hyaluronic acid as my primary moisturizer for a few years now. It works pretty well during the warmer months, as long as I apply it while my skin is still damp from washing, but when it gets cold up here in Maine the relative humidity gets looowwww. When that happens, unfortunately, I'm pretty sure that the HA serum was pulling moisture from my skin, not adding or sealing it in. So after some research I decided to give Marine Hyaluronics a try. I was really surprised by how light weight the serum is! Even better, it absorbs right in to my skin almost immediately, as long as I don't wait too long after washing my face. It doesn't leave my skin feeling oily nor does it cause me to breakout. And throughout this winter my face has felt soft and moisturized and never once has it had that tight feeling that dry skin gets in the winter. Bottom line is, if you're looking for extremely effective, lightweight moisture at any unbeatable price that doesn't feel heavy or leave your skin looking oily OR cause breakouts, you should definitely give The Ordinary's Marine Hyaluronics a try.

avis.titre: oh my god. holy grail product.
avis.texte: i bought this product a good while ago and how my face has changed since i started using it. since the hyaluronic acid 2% + b5 was too heavy for me, i purchased this. it made my skin so much smoother and hydrated. i am going to repurchase this forever and ever and ever and ever. thank you so much the ordinary
I tried several serums and this is the only one that I can tell has made a difference. I had several stubborn dry patches on my face that have now gone away thanks to this serum.

Ive been using this product regularly for almost 3 months to moisturize my dry skin and reduce the appearance of fine lines. unfortunately haven't felt much difference. Now, in winter months, my skin is preeetty dry despite regular usage:( also the product feels kind of sticky on your face and not very moisturizing

avis.titre: Has really improved my moisture levels
avis.texte: I was really struggling with dry, unhappy skin. This has really helped and my skin looks healthier and a little less old! I love the light, water like consistency. I do need to use a lot of it, and layer it on a few times a week for a max hydration so the bottle doesn't last long - I'd love to see a bigger more budget friendly bottle
I love everything in this product line and have tried this for the first time and can definitely tell a difference in moisture levels on my face.

avis.titre: Feels so Amazing on my skin! so hydrating!
avis.texte: Sharing my skincare journey because I was desperate for help when I was trying to figure out my skincare routine. I am 26 years old, fair skin, I have never had major skin issues (acne, oiliness, dryness, etc). I used to not wash my face at all, I would only use makeup remover to take off my eye makeup and that was it. Which had worked for me for literal years without any negative side effects. About a year ago, I decided to start taking care of my skin as I was noticing my skin was fairly dull. I received a free sample of Tatcha face wash so I started using this and liked it. It worked well and my skin felt good, but all of a sudden I started having extreme breakouts, mostly on my cheeks. I couldn't figure out if it was the face wash or hormonal since my physical body was going through lots of changes too. The acne would stay for months, eventually causing scarring. I switched to using Clinique face wash and lotion, which helped control the breakouts, but it wasn't reducing the scarring on my cheeks. I was also struggling with a lot of dryness around my eyes and mouth. I wanted to find a solution to the acne scarring, controlling breakouts, and dryness. I came across the Ordinary and it has helped my skin so much in the 3-4 months that I have been using it. My acne has significantly reduced, as well as the scarring reducing and my overall skin texture is much more smooth and clear. My skin is super hydrated and I feel like my skin just looks all around better. I use the Gluc

avis.titre: Great ingredients for a good value
avis.texte: I've been using this instead of hydraulic acid serums for about a year. Although the texture is a bit watery it hydrates well and calms my skin. I love the marine ingredients, it's something that I've only found in expensive skincare. I use this twice a day and follow with corsx snail mucin essence and then an active product like vitamin c or retinol. If you have an issue with the watery texture you can add it to an essence or thicker serums/moisturizers.

I started using this when I noticed my skin drying out a lot more in the fall and winter, and it's a lifesaver. Gives me long lasting, all day hydration and I use it in both my daytime and nighttime routines. :)

I love this extremely hydrating product that I use as a toner, splashing it all over my face and neck after cleansing for instant hydration. Easily absorbed it has kept eczema at bay in the harsh winter climate

I read many of the comments & had to give it a try. I absolutely love this product. I wish I had tried it sooner. I read a review from Stellam. What a great idea to transfer it to a spray bottle. I followed suit. I believe the product works better in a fine mist spray bottle. It is fragrance free, refreshing & incredibly hydrating. It makes my skin smooth, soft, supple and radiant. I've noticed less texture, fine lines diminished & still smooth the next morning. Great alternative to hyaluronic acid. I do recommend sandwiching this product in between layers of your serums and moisturizers. I hope they create a larger size. I highly recommend this product.

This is a super lightweight (water consistency) serum. I tried it a number of times, but didn't really see or feel any great hydrating (or any other) effects. My HG hydrator is The Ordinary's Amino Acids + B5 serum (that stuff is nothing short of exceptional). For lightweight hyaluronic hydrators, I prefer Timeless products.
My daughter has dry skin and started using this about a month ago. Her skin never looked better!

This goes on lightly, not as thick feeling compared to the regular hyaluronic. Surprisingly, it does the job well to lock in moisture for dry skin sufferers like me. Doesn't froth up fast like other serum but it can if you don't apply slowly.

Marine Hyaluronics is so light and watery that at first it might seem that it's not doing anything. I found it actually a lot more hydrating on my skin than the HA+B5 serum. Definitely recommended for anyone wanting a water boost without stickiness. It even has a bit of BHA in it, so who knows maybe it can help congested skin. I could use it just a bit, or even a lot at a time, but it never pilled, not even with other products applied on top. I used it pretty consistently once or twice a day for maybe about two years, always as first step after cleanse, all over my face and neck (eyelids included). Over time, my skin started reacting to something in it and had to discontinue use. I'm still giving five stars because the product itself is wonderful. I have very sensitive skin and eyes, and I know this tends to happen to me with pretty much every great product in the long run unless it gets discontinued or reformulated first.
3.5/5 stars. Ive been using for a few months and it is very calming. I have very sensitive skin and it did not have any reaction but i also didnt see any visible results

avis.titre: I like it but I dont see much change
avis.texte: 3.5 stars It is very gentle and i didnt get any bad reaction (i have VERY sensitive skin). It was light and calming but after using for a few months I dont see any long term change

I use this twice a day. On a self-care day I'll put a lot on my skin, and will use it under products like sheet masks, and under products for micro current. I also mix it in with products for my body. It is so lightweight and amazing with my skin. I was using Hyaluronic Acid originally but was consistently finding the product too much for my skin. Switching to this was the best idea, and I can use as much or as little as I want depending on the day and what I feel my skin needs. I would recommend everyone to at least give it a go, it combines well with different products I use on different days, but also on days where I want to minimise using any products, I will use this on its own or pair it with Niod's copper isolate, which is two very light weight watery products, so my skin feels fresh, clear, and attended to. For my skin as the day goes on this product mixes well with my natural oils, and I look dewy, but not oily. It feels nice, it doesn't feel like I need to wash my face, it's like a fresh barrier!

avis.titre: Don't buy if you are allergic to seafood
avis.texte: I have a seafood allergy (mainly just crab and shrimp), and I don't know if even algae, or things from the sea will affect my skin. Got an allergic reaction after several uses. Maybe this works, but not for me or ppl with seafood allergy.

avis.titre: I would literally die without it its so good
avis.texte: Ok so this was the first TO product I tried and it didnt disappoint--many ppl said this is better in consistency than their HA serum and doesn't pill and while I can't compare them since I havent used the latter, I can confirm it doesnt pill and it provide long-lasting deep hydration. it has so many humectants in it that maintain the moisture in your skin as well as salicylic acid which is an exfoliant and overall has a better ingredient list than the HA serum with a little to no chance of irritation (unless you're allergic to ingredients derived from the ocean) Overall its so amazing and my skins been so happy and hydrated after using it (and I feel like it really hydrates deep within the skin cuz after I wake up and wash my face its still hydrated and soft) its so affordable as well which is a bonus especially because the formula is so much better than some higher end products. It's so hard to find serums that don't irritate my skin (I'm extremely acne prone and used to have really bad cystic acne) but this is so gentle and non-irritating. I just repurchased it!
I have been using this for over a year. Impressive. Highly recommended. Used in my daily routine.

Are you one of those people who've tried a bazillion Serums and find that: 1. It doesn't fully absorb into your skin? 2. Leave's a layer of residue?? 3. Absorbs beautifully on its own - but then it plays up when you layer your Moisturiser over it? Well fear not, because this one is different! I have literally tried 50+ Serums from every major brand. The best of the best. Serums labelled as "Light/Water Based/Gel-Like" and still found they were not that light, nor did they absorb fully. The Ordinary's Marine Hyaluronics has the viscosity of Water. And this is why I believe it does not leave a horrible layer of residue and absorbs fully before I apply my Moisturizer. So if you have issues with the above, please give it a try. It's the lightest Serum I have encountered. Other Serums advertised as "Water Based" are often much much thicker. This is the lightest I have ever encountered

I have been using this consistently for over 4 years on my combination skin. I simply love the weightless feel on my skin and it does a great job in retaining moisture after cleansing /washing and preps the skin well for follow up serums. Yes the consistency is watery and yes spillages do occur if your not careful but I would never exclude this from regime - my skin feels naked without it whilst at the same time being affordable.
This is my first water-based serum. I like that it is odorless and absorbs instantly. Moisturizes well. I only use it at night after deep cleansing.

After starting a new medication, my skin has become so oily that I'll break out. I was strictly using The Ordinary salicylic acid 2%, which did it's job a little too well and dried my skin out. Now I alternate using this marine hyaluronic. It keeps my face so moisturized throughout the day and it doesn't cause a breakout or make me look oily. It's lightweight and absorbs quickly. It is also super layerable with other products.

I've been using the Marine Hyaluronics Serum for a few weeks now, and I am absolutely thrilled with what it's doing to my skin. Previously, I was using the Hyaluronic Acid serum but it just doesn't play well with my skin and other products (it pills so easily ugh) This on the other hand, feels like a burst of hydration from the depths of the ocean, and my skin drinks it up eagerly. Since I started using it, I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin's overall hydration levels. It looks plump, radiant, and feels incredibly smooth to the touch. Overall, the Marine Hyaluronics Serum is a game-changer for me. It delivers on its promise of intense hydration, and I've seen a noticeable improvement in the suppleness and overall health of my skin. It's an affordable gem that has earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine

Been using marine hyaluronics for about a month, and it's my favourite product in my routine. I live in a very dry region and have always struggled with excess oil. Well having adequate hydration has reduced my oil significantly and my skin feels plump and moisturized! My one ask is please please please make a larger size, I got through the little bottle so fast.

It is a nightmare to find products that work for my skin because 1. it's so fussy to ingredients 2. it's hard to find something that addresses all my skin types/issues which are: dehydrated, combo leaning oily, easily congested , acne prone, sensitive and hyper pigmentation. For some reason hyaloronic scid just never really worked for me, in fact it felt like it was absorbing all the water from my skin rather than than the environment and products and my skin would just look dull and dry. Having used this serum I have seen major changes, it seems to help to retain hydration and restore my skin barrier as my acne scars that I've had for months a slowly fade away. I know it's this serum because it's the only thing I've changed in my routine.

I bought this serum after reading about making a dupe of La Mer cream by mixing The Ordinary Marine Hyaluronics with the German version of Nivea cream . They don't actually mix well together, so I layer them. I can't use products with squalene or shea butter on my face because they clog my skin and I develop milia. This has the same or better moisturizing and plumping effect as squalene/shea butter, but it feels lighter and more fresh on my face rather than heavy and clogging like squalene/shea butter.

The is the only product that gives my skin deep hydration that lasts the whole day and the only skin care product that I cannot live without. I have sensitive to normal skin. My boyfriend also likes it because it so lightweight and non-greasy. It's almost as fluid as water and the application takes some getting used to but it's probably the most effective product I've ever used!

Absolutely love this light weight serum that does not pill. We need this in a larger bottle! 120 ml or more please! I work in aviation and spend more time in airplanes than I do on the ground, so this product is my Holy grail when it comes to hydration. Larger bottles - please!

I've been using this for years. Although I use it all year, it is my go to summer moisturizer. Lightweight enough that I can sweat normally. With creamy products, when I sweat it gets slimy/uncomfortable. I even started mixing it with my foundation before application (1-2 drops) with amazing results. It helps to make an even application, without dry patches. Loooove this product. I gift it to people. :)

I love this serum. It's incredible for hydration and making my skin plump! The only thing is, my most recent bottle was left in my mailbox for a few days (in some pretty high heat) and I'm worried the heat might affect the integrity of the product. Anyone know anything about this?

avis.titre: PLEASE WE NEED A JUMBO SIZE!
avis.texte: I had it previously...Please we need 60ml and 120ml bottles, I use it normally and it would be better if we can get a jumbo size product directly :) It would be great also for environment (we would need less packages each time) Thank you very much, your customer service is very good!!! :)

This is by far the best hydrating serum I have tried from the ordinary even other drugstore brands. The only problem is that it is not available in larger bottles!!! The Ordinary, please make large bottles for this one!!!!!

avis.titre: This product needs a larger bottle!
avis.texte: I like this better than the regular Hyaluronic 2%+B5 but since it doesn't come in a larger size I don't buy it often. It works for me to use a bit after washing then to layer over it a moisturizing lotion or light oil. Especially on skin dried out from swimming, etc.. But since it is such a small bottle it seems silly to use it, for example, on my neck, chest, or arms and run out of it all the time. It's bad enough that the large tub of Hyaluronic acid gel was discontinued even though it sold very well (many times it was sold out). So 4 stars but only because the bottle is too small - not sure if I'd recommend this unless someone wanted to only use it on their face.

I finally picked this up after some recco's from friends. Loooooove this. If you're not a huge HA fan, because of consistency, tackiness etc you will love this! Its like water and so cheap that you can really indulge. Sodium Hyaluronate is already in everything anyway so this is a refreshing alternative! If you're looking for something quite fluid still, but a taf thicker and a little more of a shiny finish, check out Amino Acids + B5 (Love her in the winter)

I grabbed this product after reading the rave reviews. What I failed to do before purchasing it was to carefully read the product description. It is VERY lightweight, and while it is causing my skin no harm, it isn't doing anything for it, either. Like, nothing AT ALL. I've used it for over a month now on my dry and mature skin, and, well, crickets. So I guess it's not a miracle serum for everybody. I'm giving it two stars since it's not causing any problem, and maybe, just maybe, it IS doing something but so subtle that it's not noticeable.

I live in a dry extremely low humidity climate so hyaluronic acid is not an ideal option due to its moisture-pulling nature that further drys out my skin. However, I have discovered that this serum works WONDERS on my dehydrated and dry skin. It has noticeably reduced my acne, leaving my face remarkably smooth. My skin now feels healthy and revitalized, appearing plump instead of dried out. Think of a dried out dish sponge vs a soaked dish sponge haha. On occasion, I use The Ordinary's rosehip oil between the Marine serum and my moisturizer, resulting in remarkably smooth skin. ;) I love the consistency of this serum as well it's incredibly easy to work with and a little goes a long way. I also love that this serum is in a dropper bottle, but my only con is that there isn't a bigger size of this serum. Please release a bigger bottle of this serum. If you live in a humid environment HA is the way to go, if you live in a low humidity environment an option such as this Marine serum is the way to go.

avis.titre: Breaking out way more than usual
avis.texte: Since I starting to use this, I've been breaking out more than usual and in places that I normally have issues (cheeks, above mouth, tip of nose). I started using the the Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2% at the same time, so I'm not sure which is responsible but I don't plan to keep using either of them.

I bought this bc of the great reviews. I usually buy the regular hyaluronic acid serum from the ordinary and saw people saying this one was so much better for hydration. It's not bad at all, but I like the original HA better and will be going back.
Good for combination skin in summer, much lighter than the original, but why is there no larger size please?

Started using 2-3 weeks ago and noticed my skin has broken out in small red lumpy patches above my upper lip and low on chin. Pretty much mirrors what another user said about it giving her eczema. Not for me!

I live in Arizona, and go on hikes every single day. It's hot and dry. I slather on sunscreen for my dawn hikes, and I always end up with congested upset skin… so I can't use heavy moisturizers with too many ingredients, or it just breaks me out! This serum is a life saver. I wash my face with oil, then foaming cleanser, then I put this on, then I finish with a moisturizer/sun screen for the rest of my day. This is all I need to add to my routine for plump glowing skin. Absolutely obsessed. I will be buying this for the foreseeable future!

I n e v e r leave reviews but I've been using it only for about 3 weeks and I'm honestly obsessed with how well it works for my dry, acne and redness prone skin! I previously used the HA 2% + B5 serum and was satisfied with the results but I did not like how it felt on my skin. This watery consistency not only feels amazing on my skin but also leaves my skin more hydrated than ever.

avis.titre: Great product but NOT for me.
avis.texte: I bought the product on April 29th and retuned it on May 2nd. It was the only new product that added to my regimen and I immediately got multiple breakouts on my chin. I could feel them forming as the day went on. Not sure why my face reacted the way that it did, when everyone I know of had good luck with it. And besides that it did make my sensitive and dry face feel good. Just with breakouts. Face improved the minute I stopped 😞 I would recommend to others. Just not right for my skin.

This is by far one of my fav products to use before any SPF cream. I love how it spreads on my skin and the moisture it provides. Still I don't get why the formulation contains Salicylic Acid, as it is best suited for oily skin and acne-prone skin, and this marine hyaluronics targets dryness

avis.titre: Not as good as regular hyaluronic serum
avis.texte: It does the job, I thought it'd be worth a try since I love other ordinary products. It leaves leftover residue and has a weird consistency that transfers to the skin, just stick with the hyaluronic serum.

avis.titre: Applies like foamy water. Lightweight and workable
avis.texte: I was not expecting this product to be the consistency of water, it kind of put me off at first. I live in extreme low humidity (under 10% most of the year) and heavy humectants do more damage than benefit. I use an absurd amount of this stuff layering everyday on wet skin and I seal it in with heavy occlusives. I've seen a significant difference around my lips. It's immediately noticable. I like it. I have very dry sensitive/reactive skin, but this product never irritated me. I recommend using it as a base layer for hydration, or for oily skin types in normal weather conditions.

I can't say how this works alone because I always use serums and lotion after, but it really works well! I don't like hyaluronic acid, it just doesn't work well on me and makes my face feel dry and tight. I use a pretty drying face wash (Olay Deep Gel Cleaner with Tea Tree oil) so I need some instant hydration. I use this first, followed by Amino Acid + B5 with 2 drops of Pycnogenol, then facial lotion. Glycolic Acid 3x a week. Works great! I'm 42 and my skin has never looked better! This is a great alternative to HA, and has no interactions. Goes on like water, doesn't irritate skin, and is wonderful as a base for other serums! Worth giving it a shot!

avis.titre: Much Preferred over Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5
avis.texte: I used Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 for a while and I was completely content with its effects & hydration. However, I decided to try Marine Hyaluronics instead and it felt like a new world. I was able to receive the same hydrating effects minus the thicker serum and sticky feeling. Tip: Apply a facial spray then the Marine Hyaluronics for added hydration and easier spreadability. I do agree that the Marine Hyaluronics is harder to handle as it is watery, but you just have to work fast.

I've gone through about 5 bottles of this, and I love it. It's the only HA I've found that completely penetrates into the skin instead of sitting on top, feeling sticky. I love the watery texture, just be careful because it's easy to spill! My skin LOVES this fomula.

avis.titre: Much, much better than HA + B5!
avis.texte: I love this product so much more than The Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid + B5. That one is sticky, a little too thick, and doesn't smell very nice. This one isn't sticky, is a lot thinner (allowing you to use a little less, while allowing it to absorb more effectively), and doesn't have much of a smell at all! I love it.
Love this so much! Super light weight! I'm going to continue to buy this! Perfect for any skin types!I don't have any cons abt it yet!

I've been using this for well over 2 months. I'm not sure I can say I've seen much of a change in my skin from this.. it does appear to hydrate my skin anymore than just my moisturizer. With that being said.. it hasn't cause any irritation or breakouts and I tend to have sensitive skin and acne prone. I don't care for the consistency of this product, it's sticky.

I found this product was a little much for me on my face in summer if I was using another moisturizer (though I still have oily skin most places in my mid 40's). So I started using it only on my lips after cleansing, and then using a moisturizer and greasier protectant on them afterwards. If my lips are very chapped and dry, the marine hyraluronics immediately makes them more like normal skin. I do need other stuff on top to create more of barrier afterwards, though. I am ordering again just for my lips alone. Product is quite liquid with slight gel like consistency, so only 1-2 drops are needed. Doesn't really smell like anything.

This did not change my skin in any way. It did not moisturize or irritate it. It was just nothing. I would not recommend this product. The Ordinary has many moisturizing products that work and this isn't one of them.

Before I added this serum into my routine, my skin was surviving. But now it's thriving. This stuff is lightweight, hydrating, and a fantastic option. I can't use the hyaluronic acid serum because it's too thick. This one is perfect, other than the fact that you need a lot. A bigger sized bottle option would work since this stuff is good for a year after opening and I get through one bottle a month. However for the price point, accessibility, and performance, 10/10.

avis.titre: Did more harm than good for me
avis.texte: I wanted to try this out after finally throwing out the hyaluronic acid serum, which never made any difference, but unfortunately this one was even worse for me. Not only did it not help with skin hydration at all as far as I can tell, but it also broke me out and gave me small eczema patches - I've never had eczema before, so that was extremely disappointing. Considering I've used all other products in my routine consistently for a month by now, it's really the only product that could've caused this. Not sure why my skin reacted the way it did, normally I can tolerate pretty much anything. Ah well.

Skin is noticeably less dry after consistent usage, not quite *the* miracle product for me but it definitely works, plus it somehow FEELS moisturizing on the skin, it's very pleasant. Only issue is that I'm not sure if it's non-comedogenic, I haven't noticed any major bumps (that weren't already there lol) but I'd have caution if your pores clog easily.
this serum is super lightweight but very hydrating. I use it AM and PM.

avis.titre: So good I buy two at a time
avis.texte: I love this product for my dry skin definitely something I use in combination with other products. I can also use this under my makeup and it won't pill!

Ya'll, I am not exaggerating when I say this serum transformed my skin, and I've been very into skincare for more than a decade trying all sorts of products, k-beauty/asian skincare, high end, etc. Hyaluronic products irritate my skin as I live in a drier climate and have sensitive skin, but this gives me the softest, plumpest, and most glowy texture I've ever had, and you only need a few drops on damp skin. Sidenote, I found this product after researching what ingredients made La Mer skincare products special compared to its dupes, and it's the seaweed:) So seriously give this a try. I won't gatekeep even though it's tempting..

avis.titre: In love from the first application
avis.texte: Dears, I have just recently purchased this product and have been using this in my AM routine under my makeup. The face looks glowing, the skin is plump and no fine lines are visible - there is no product buildup in them! One important thing to mention - I have been using retinoid 2% in my PM routine, which helped regulate oily patches of my skin a lot (combination skin type). Those two products make a good team for me. To remark on the texture of the product, it is very runny and easy to apply, it's lightweight and manageable. And the smell is gorgeous!

avis.titre: Is it supposed to be so watery?
avis.texte: I am not sure about this product. In the past my hyaluronic products have had a slight gel feel to them thereby leaving my face feeling hydrated. This item is SO watery it runs off my face if I am not careful it kind of dries before I have time to spread it around evenly. Did I get a defective bottle? If this is the true product then I give it a 1 if I got a defective bottle then there might still be hope.

Today is the first day using marine hyaluronics and my skin has never felt this much hydrated without feeling too oily! I usually have oily skin when im at school and dry skin in the winter and this product will make my life 100% easier.
This makes my skin feel amazing. And not just to touch, I put it on and I can feel my skin going "oooooh, yes, thank you." Please keep this forever!

avis.titre: Plump and hydrated skin, but comedogenic?
avis.texte: It DEFINITELY hydrates the skin. I've always had dry skin, but as soon as you put this on it instantly adds some bounce to your skin. A great base especially for the winter months and night time. I did however notice that I get whiteheads, but unsure if it's because of this product. Is it comedogenic? Did anyone experience the same? Thank you!

avis.titre: It is not the same as normal hyaluronic acid.
avis.texte: I didn't like it because you don't feel the sensation of filling in the skin as with the other hyaluronic acid. Also, it's too light and dries out on your hands before it hits your skin. Don't buy this one, buy the other hyaluronic acid, the other one is better.
Feels amazing! Very watery however blends easily onto the skin directly after cleansing. Feels soft and provides clarity to my skin tone. Happily recommended.

avis.titre: Started keeping it in the refrigerator!
avis.texte: I've lost count if I'm in my third or fourth bottle, but I love this 100%! I love the watery consistency. This product perfect for me after exfoliating/ dermaplaning/ acid peel. And now especially nice since I've been storing it in the refrigerator (I actually do not know if this is OK for the product or not? Can anyone say?)

Been using a whole bunch of stuff from the ordinary, Buffet, Euk 014, mosturising factors HA, rosehip seed oil, alpha arbutin, mandelic acid and this marine hyaluronic acid, so dont know exactly which reduced my malar bag, but I think hydration played a major part in filling in over it, to give a blended look, which is a drastic improvement!
Definitely the best hyaluronic acid serum that I have tried (of many). Great on my sensitive skin. Love the long-lasting hydration and I always feel that marine hyaluronics deliver the best results!

It seems like my pores have just disappeared. My skin feels smoother and looks more youthful. I am a huge Ordinary fan. I've bought lots of their products, and they're the best thing I've put on my face. This will be a regular in my daily routine.

avis.titre: Amazing results for face and for hair!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for 5+ years on my face, and LOVE it! Recently I started experimenting with weekly scalp massage with different oils, which has made my hair thicker and shinier but also quickly greasy. I tried this on a whim, since it's so lightweight, I massaged into my scalp for 5 minutes before washing my hair, and the result is incredible! My hair is soft, shiny, healthy looking but NOT GREASY even after 2 days!

I bought this about two weeks ago and I noticed results after a few days of usage! It helps so much in keeping my skin hydrated throughout my day (especially with masks on) and avoiding tightness in the afternoon that tends to creep up on me. Something that I think really helped was to apply water on your face like a serum and letting it dry a bit before layering your toner 1-3 times and then using this toner after another water splash.

make it bigger! we love it, but its so tiny, and with such a watery texture, we go through it like crazy, it's almost ridiculous how small the bottle is, with my daughter and I both using it, we go through nearly a bottle a week!

Love the light watery texture of this and wish other products came in this format! I hate layering thick gummy serums and creams but this one fits right into any regimen. It's also useful for diluting other products like NMF in your hand to make them spread more easily. Please, more formulas like this without thickeners!

avis.titre: No effect, feels like water on face
avis.texte: I used this for over a year, and then stopped using it, and there was zero difference. Feels like putting water on my face, and therefore a waste of money. Would not recommend.

It does everything it claims to and hydrates but the design and packaging is so faulty. Since the product is very liquidity it spills out easy if the container is knocked over. That's exactly what happened today and half the product spilled out in 0.2 seconds. This isn't the first time that this happened too! I wish and hope that they change the packaging somehow.

Questa è vera magia in bottiglia, mi rammarico di non averlo scoperto prima. Iniziamo dall odore: è talmente delicato che non saprei proprio dire di che cosa sappia (cose naturali), so solo che si avverte a fatica e che comunque sparisce in meno di un minuto. Metto 4 o 5 gocce una prima volta sul viso ancora umido dopo la detersione, poi contorno occhi Niod quindi ancora 3 o 4 gocce. Ed ecco la magia, potrei finirla lì se fossi ancora una ragazza intorno ai 20/30 anni con una pelle quasi perfetta. Purtroppo non è così quindi proseguo con varie delle meraviglie Deciem tipo TO Alfa Arbutina 2% + HA, TO Ascorbic Acid 8% + Alpha Arbutina 2% ecc. Avevo due zone secche ai lati del naso che non volevano andarsene, con HM in due giorni sparite! Non potrò mai consigliarlo abbastanza.
I had been using hc months before and found it sticky even with a moist face ... this beauty is lighter and I have oily skin . It soaks right in . It works perfectly before retinol I love ❤️ it
I have been using it for roughly a year now, I very much like the product. It makes my skin look plump and hydrated. Works much better Hyaluronic acid. Would definitely recommend it.

Since I have a very dehydrated skin (but not dry), this product is absolutely a "must" for me. The consistency is super light weight and it absorbs well. It leaves my skin feeling a little moist to the touch, which is what I want. It is very easy to layer with other products. In fact, I mix it with a few drops of pycnogenol. This product has never pilled (a very common problem for me). I am very impressed with the results.
This stuff is amazing, I add to my face and edges of my hair in order to retain moisture. The only thing is I go through the stuff so much, so please release a bigger version!

Please, please, please can we have BIGGER bottles, l can't get enough of the stuff, it really does work, l am 77 and no one believes my age, my skin looks plump and firm, a product l CANNOT live without, but l do always add a SPF 50 moisturiser on top during the day and a night cream after applying it at night ..l cannot recommend this product enough...thank you guys XX

Of The Ordinary's 2 hyaluronic serums, this one is def the best for my skin. The other one would become tacky n pill when I used it with other serums n was difficult to use because of its higher viscosity. I mist, pat like 8 drops on, then mist again once it's no longer watery and then continue with my routine. I've definitely noticed more hydration and reduced lines! :-) Love this product!

This is great for the extra bump into plumping and hydration! Been using this for over a year. I like to add it into eye masks to help plump my lines. Works great under makeup. I'm the lucky middle aged woman with some aging and super dry skin :(..

I was using the regular HA, Buffet, Glycolic acid and the HA moisturizer. Also using salicylic acid. Recently switched out the regular HA with this one and switched Buffet to Buffer + Copper. I am not kidding, my skin got about 50% smoother overnight. I think it's mainly attributed to this product. My skin LOVES it, soaks in so so so well. I will never go back to regular HA.
